description: Brain extraction with FSL BET, run from Neurodesk's FSL container. Writes the brain-only image and a binary brain mask on the input grid. In the NeuroVue Neurodesk app the latest FSL module is on PATH; each run starts FSL in a nested Apptainer container from CVMFS.

t1.description: Head image to skull-strip, typically a T1-weighted scan.

frac.description: Fractional intensity threshold (0 to 1); smaller values give larger brain estimates.

block.label: Brain extraction (FSL BET, Neurodesk)
block.description: Skull-strip a head image with FSL BET.

requirements: FSL from Neurodesk (bet on PATH, or via NEURODESK_BET)
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs bet <t1> <outputDir>/brain -f <frac> -m through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: FSL runs from Neurodesk's CVMFS in a nested Apptainer container. Check that CVMFS is mounted (ls /cvmfs/neurodesk.ardc.edu.au/containers) and that this host allows unprivileged user namespaces.
